```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(R2jags)
library(coda)
library(patchwork)

main_path <- getwd()
data_path <- file.path(main_path, "data/cleaned_data")
study_2_path <- file.path(main_path, "study_2")
models_path <- file.path(main_path, "models")
results_path <- file.path(main_path, "results")

figure_path <- file.path(study_2_path, "figures/simulation_sensitivity")
dir.create(figure_path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

set.seed(7386)

demographics <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "demographics.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
roundwise_clean <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "roundwise_clean.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

source(file.path(main_path, "overall_functions.R"))

```


```{r}
#analytic sample
dem_solo_analytic <- demographics %>%
  filter(
    setup == "SOLO",
    !excluded,
    !participant.code %in% c("l6gxo7po", "n0ndmyka")
  ) # Two participants excluded due to technical errors

solo_ids <- dem_solo_analytic %>%
  distinct(id)

solo_rounds <- roundwise_clean %>%
  filter(!excluded, setup == "SOLO") %>%
  semi_join(solo_ids, by = "id")
```

```{r}
# Derive duration and sound-condition variables
solo_rounds <- solo_rounds %>%
  mutate(
    gender = factor(gender, levels = c("Female", "Male")),
    completed = as.integer(completed),
    secs = as.numeric(secs),
    log_secs = log(secs + 1),
    any_sound = as.integer(replace_na(any_stimulus, FALSE)),
    sound1_lower = str_to_lower(coalesce(sound1_stimulus, "")),
    sound2_lower = str_to_lower(coalesce(sound2_stimulus, "")),
    sound3_lower = str_to_lower(coalesce(sound3_stimulus, "")),
    any_cry = as.integer(
      str_detect(sound1_lower, "cry|cries") |
        str_detect(sound2_lower, "cry|cries") |
        str_detect(sound3_lower, "cry|cries")),
    any_alarm = as.integer(
      str_detect(sound1_lower, "alarm") |
        str_detect(sound2_lower, "alarm") |
        str_detect(sound3_lower, "alarm")),
    round_sound_type = case_when(
      any_sound == 0 ~ "none",
      any_cry == 1 & any_alarm == 0 ~ "cry_only",
      any_cry == 0 & any_alarm == 1 ~ "alarm_only",
      any_cry == 1 & any_alarm == 1 ~ "mixed_cry_alarm"),
    round_sound_type = factor(
      round_sound_type,
      levels = c(
        "none",
        "alarm_only",
        "cry_only",
        "mixed_cry_alarm"))) %>%
  filter(round_sound_type != "mixed_cry_alarm") %>%
  droplevels()
```

```{r}
duration_df <- solo_rounds %>%
  filter(
    completed == 1,
    round_sound_type %in% c("none", "alarm_only", "cry_only"),
    !is.na(log_secs),
    !is.na(gender),
    !is.na(participant.code)) %>%
  droplevels() %>%
  mutate(
    gender = relevel(gender, ref = "Female"),
    round_sound_type = relevel(
      round_sound_type,
      ref = "none"))

duration_model_df <- duration_df %>%
  mutate(
    gender_num = if_else(gender == "Male", 1L, 0L),
    sound_num = case_when(
      round_sound_type == "none" ~ 1L,
      round_sound_type == "alarm_only" ~ 2L,
      round_sound_type == "cry_only" ~ 3L),
    participant_id = as.integer(factor(participant.code)))
```

```{r}
samples_primary <- readRDS(file.path(results_path, "s2_jags_duration_sound_gender.rds"))

primary_summary <-
  samples_primary$BUGSoutput$summary %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("parameter")

b0_sim <- primary_summary %>%
  filter(parameter == "b0") %>%
  pull(mean)

b_gender_sim <- primary_summary %>%
  filter(parameter == "b_gender") %>%
  pull(mean)

b_alarm_female_sim <- primary_summary %>%
  filter(parameter == "b_sound[2]") %>%
  pull(mean)

b_alarm_gender_sim <- primary_summary %>%
  filter(parameter == "b_sound_gender[2]") %>%
  pull(mean)

cry_female_observed <- primary_summary %>%
  filter(parameter == "cry_vs_none_female") %>%
  pull(mean)

cry_male_observed <- primary_summary %>%
  filter(parameter == "cry_vs_none_male") %>%
  pull(mean)

cry_average_sim <-
  (cry_female_observed + cry_male_observed) / 2

sigma_participant_sim <- primary_summary %>%
  filter(parameter == "sigma_participant") %>%
  pull(mean)

sigma_sim <- primary_summary %>%
  filter(parameter == "sigma") %>%
  pull(mean)
```

```{r}
true_cry_gender_differences <- c(
  0.00,
  0.05,
  0.10,
  0.15,
  0.20,
  0.21,
  0.22,
  0.25,
  0.30)

n_sim <- 500
```

```{r}
run_one_simulation <- function(
    true_delta,
    simulation_number) {

  # True cry effects while holding their average constant
  b_cry_female_sim <- cry_average_sim + true_delta / 2

  b_cry_gender_sim <- -true_delta

  # New participant random intercepts for this simulated dataset
  participant_effects <- rnorm(
    n = n_distinct(
      duration_model_df$participant_id),
    mean = 0,
    sd = sigma_participant_sim)

  # Expected log duration for every observed design row
  mu_sim <-
    b0_sim +
    b_gender_sim *
      duration_model_df$gender_num +
    if_else(
      duration_model_df$sound_num == 2L,
      b_alarm_female_sim,
      if_else(
        duration_model_df$sound_num == 3L,
        b_cry_female_sim,
        0)) +
    duration_model_df$gender_num *
      if_else(
        duration_model_df$sound_num == 2L,
        b_alarm_gender_sim,
        if_else(
          duration_model_df$sound_num == 3L,
          b_cry_gender_sim,
          0)) +
    participant_effects[duration_model_df$participant_id]

  y_sim <- rnorm(
    n = nrow(duration_model_df),
    mean = mu_sim,
    sd = sigma_sim)

  sim_data <- list(
    N = nrow(duration_model_df),
    J = n_distinct(
      duration_model_df$participant_id),
    y = y_sim,
    gender = as.integer(
      duration_model_df$gender_num),
    sound = as.integer(
      duration_model_df$sound_num),
    participant = as.integer(
      duration_model_df$participant_id))

  sim_fit <- jags.parallel(
    data = sim_data,
    inits = NULL,
    parameters.to.save = c(
      "gender_diff_cry"),
    model.file = file.path(
      models_path,
      "s2_sound_effect_simulation.bugs"),
    n.chains = 4,
    n.iter = 5000,
    n.burnin = 1000,
    n.thin = 1)

  sim_summary <-
    sim_fit$BUGSoutput$summary[
      "gender_diff_cry",
      ,
      drop = FALSE]

  tibble(
    true_delta = true_delta,
    simulation = simulation_number,
    estimate = sim_summary[1, "mean"],
    lower = sim_summary[1, "2.5%"],
    upper = sim_summary[1, "97.5%"],
    Rhat = sim_summary[1, "Rhat"],
    ESS = sim_summary[1, "n.eff"],
    detected =
      sim_summary[1, "2.5%"] > 0)
}
```

```{r}
simulation_results <- list()

for (delta in true_cry_gender_differences) {

  delta_label <- str_replace_all(
    format(delta, nsmall = 2),
    "\\.",
    "_")

  simulation_path <- file.path(
    results_path,
    paste0(
      "s2_simulation_sensitivity_delta_",
      delta_label,
      ".rds"))

  if (file.exists(simulation_path)) {

    delta_results <-
      readRDS(simulation_path)

  } else {

    delta_results <- map_dfr(
      seq_len(n_sim),
      ~ run_one_simulation(
        true_delta = delta,
        simulation_number = .x))

    saveRDS(delta_results, simulation_path)
  }

  simulation_results[[
    as.character(delta)
  ]] <- delta_results
}

simulation_results <- bind_rows(simulation_results)
```

```{r}
simulation_convergence <- simulation_results %>%
  summarise(
    max_Rhat = max(Rhat, na.rm = TRUE),
    proportion_Rhat_above_1_05 =
      mean(Rhat > 1.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_ESS = min(ESS, na.rm = TRUE))

simulation_convergence

simulation_convergence_by_effect <-
  simulation_results %>%
  group_by(true_delta) %>%
  summarise(
    max_Rhat = max(Rhat, na.rm = TRUE),
    proportion_Rhat_above_1_05 =
      mean(Rhat > 1.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_ESS = min(ESS, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")

simulation_convergence_by_effect
```

```{r}
simulation_sensitivity <- simulation_results %>%
  group_by(true_delta) %>%
  summarise(
    n_simulations = n(),
    n_detected = sum(detected),
    detection_probability = mean(detected),
    monte_carlo_se = sqrt(
      detection_probability *
        (1 - detection_probability) /
        n_simulations),
    mc_lower = pmax(
      0,
      detection_probability -
        1.96 * monte_carlo_se),
    mc_upper = pmin(
      1,
      detection_probability +
        1.96 * monte_carlo_se),
    .groups = "drop")

simulation_sensitivity

```



```{r}
p_simulation_sensitivity <- ggplot(
  simulation_sensitivity,
  aes(
    x = true_delta,
    y = detection_probability)) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0.80,
    linetype = 2) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(
    size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = pmax(
        0,
        detection_probability -
          1.96 * monte_carlo_se),
      ymax = pmin(
        1,
        detection_probability +
          1.96 * monte_carlo_se)),
    width = 0.005) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    labels = scales::percent_format(
      accuracy = 1)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "True female-male difference in infant-cry effect",
    y = "Probability that 95% CrI excludes zero in predicted direction")

plot_png_path <- file.path(
  figure_path,
  "s2_simulation_sensitivity_cry_gender_difference.png")

show_or_save_ggplot(
  plot_png_path = plot_png_path,
  plot_object = p_simulation_sensitivity,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300)
```
